    Replacing the last arrow of an efficient tackle #

    Construct the dependent hook-tackle obtained by replacing its last rho with a compatible irreducible morphism. Since both old and new last hooks have depth one, the efficiency word is unchanged. This turns the order conclusion for Figures 57--60 into the exact BGRS 8.5 efficient-hook lemma. The orientation-dual cohook replacement is packaged in the same way.

          The cohook-dual BGRS Lemma 8.5: if the last cohook and two alternative irreducible arrows form one of the fixed-target Figures 57--60, one outer arrow is the last cohook of an efficient replacement tackle with the same prefix.
